escalation_state_consistency.name: escalation_state_consistency
escalation_state_consistency.value: "ticket_escalations"."status" IN ('open', 'acknowledged', 'resolved') AND (("ticket_escalations"."acknowledged_by" IS NULL) = ("ticket_escalations"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL)) AND (("ticket_escalations"."resolved_by" IS NULL) = ("ticket_escalations"."resolved_at" IS NULL)) AND (("ticket_escalations"."status" = 'resolved') = ("ticket_escalations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("ticket_escalations"."status" <> 'acknowledged' OR "ticket_escalations"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("ticket_escalations"."status" <> 'open' OR "ticket_escalations"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL)

template_lengths.name: template_lengths
template_lengths.value: length(trim("response_templates"."title")) BETWEEN 2 AND 100 AND length(trim("response_templates"."body")) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000

sla_policy_bounds.name: sla_policy_bounds
sla_policy_bounds.value: "sla_policies"."response_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 525600 AND "sla_policies"."resolution_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 525600 AND "sla_policies"."warning_percent" BETWEEN 1 AND 99

ticket_resolution_details_consistency.name: ticket_resolution_details_consistency
ticket_resolution_details_consistency.value: (("tickets"."resolved_by" IS NULL) = ("tickets"."resolution_summary" IS NULL)) AND ("tickets"."resolved_by" IS NULL OR ("tickets"."status" IN ('resolved','closed') AND length(trim("tickets"."resolution_summary")) BETWEEN 20 AND 5000)) AND ("tickets"."closed_by" IS NULL OR "tickets"."status" = 'closed')

ticket_resolution_consistency.name: ticket_resolution_consistency
ticket_resolution_consistency.value: (("tickets"."status" IN ('resolved','closed')) = ("tickets"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("tickets"."status" = 'closed') = ("tickets"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL))
